About Meyer Grain
Independently owned and operated,
Meyer Grain is the most competitive grain drying, storage, and trucking company in Northwestern Wisconsin.
Between our two facilities — in Elk Mound and Pleasant Valley —
we store more than 6 million bushels of grain each season,
can dry up to 12,000 bushels an hour,
and have a fleet of 25 tractors and various trailers available for transportation needs.
With four dump sites in Elk Mound and two in Pleasant Valley,
as well as 260,000 bushels of wet grain storage,
our operations are built to get you rolling across the scale, weighed, tested,
and dumped both quickly and efficiently.
